title: ResolvedSources
description: Canonical metadata for every cited source after Stage 2 identifier resolution. Sibling to 02_existence.json — the existence-stage findings carry verdicts; this artifact carries the resolved metadata (title/authors/year/venue + retraction status + venue quality). paper_id field shape is byte-compatible with deep-research/schemas/sources.json so deep-research's sources.json can be consumed in lieu of this artifact when intake.pinned_sidecars is populated (v2 follow-on). Validated by scripts/validate_artifact.py --kind resolved_sources against schema + predicates S1/S2/S4/V1/V2.

paper_id.description: Stable join key. DOI-preferred, PMID fallback, slug last resort. Byte-compatible with deep-research/schemas/sources.json#paper_id.

resolution_paths.description: Chronological log of identifier-lookup attempts. At least one entry required since Stage 2 always logs the attempt, even on failure.

editorial_notices.description: Null when the Scite editorialNotices probe has not run. When the probe ran with no notices, encode as {type:'NONE', fetched_at:...} so P7 audit trail captures the probe attempt.

outcome.description: Outcome of this single identifier-lookup attempt. The source-level verdict is computed downstream by combining the chronological log.

metadata_mismatch_fields.description: When outcome == METADATA_MISMATCH, which fields disagreed (e.g. ['year','venue']). Empty otherwise.

type.description: NONE = probe ran and found no notices (records the attempt for P7 audit trail). Other values record found notices.

concern.description: 'none' = probe ran and venue is clean (records the attempt). Other values flag concerns.
